title: A Guide to Developing Trade Systems That Use Both Magical and Technological Resources
use_cases: Use when building a galaxy-spanning empire that requires robust trade networks across both magical and technological realms.
Implement when balancing the availability of magical versus technological goods to reflect cultural dynamics and drive narrative conflict.
Configure when designing interstellar economies to create realism and depth in your world.
Apply when tying trade systems into the politics, cultures, and tensions of your fictional setting.
content:
Whether you’re building a galaxy-spanning empire, a cluster of magic-infused star systems, or a spacefaring fantasy civilization, interstellar trade is the lifeblood of a living universe. Trade and economics add depth, conflict, realism, and opportunity for stories to unfold.

In this guide, we’ll dive into how you can design believable, exciting interstellar economies that incorporate both magical and technological resources, while giving you tools to tie them into the cultures, politics, and tensions of your world.
